title: Hinomori Shizuku — MORE MORE JUMP!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hi... Look at you, grinning like you've just won something. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? Do I look unusually happy?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're beaming your happiness all around.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It must be because of the dream I had last night.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Was it that good?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! I dreamed about back when I was in training.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To become an idol?

rows.Speaker: Idol Candiate A
rows.Line: There are other girls better than her at dancing and singing...

rows.Speaker: Idol Candiate B
rows.Line: She gets preferential treatment only because of her pretty face.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku had to endure jealous girls saying nasty things about her back then...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's to like about dreaming of that time in your life?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At first, I thought it would be a bad dream too, but it developed into something nice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It started with another trainee idol being mean to me, and then I was left tied up on a floating island in the middle of a swimming pool, and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold on, what did you just say?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was left tied up on a floating island in the middle of a swimming pool.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's so totally random.
A floating island? In a POOL? And on top of that, you were tied up?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (On second thought, that's not too far off from what I had to undergo in those variety shows...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Well, I guess dreams can be crazy like that, huh.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, what happened after?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was feeling helpless, but then Happy Everyday, the Masked Variety Idol, came to my rescue!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, whaaat! It can't be...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She was magnificent!
She leaped high up in the air and was just about to reach me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But just as she was making that last jump to get to you, she slipped and fell into the pool?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh... How did you know my dream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because that's exactly what happened in one of the variety shows I appeared in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I knew it seemed familiar, somehow. So that's why.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You only realized that now?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. So that's where the name came from, Happy Everyday, the Masked Variety Idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't really want to hear that name ever again!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But going back to my dream...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, stop! I don't want to know!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's not go back to it, ever!
You'd better go to your desk and get ready for class.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I haven't finished—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You don't need to!
Shoo! Back to your desk!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I was just getting to the best part...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (In my dream, Airi slips and falls into the pool, like she said...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But she resolutely swims back to the shore of the island and unties me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She then says, No matter how uncertain or tough things get, keep looking forward!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Airi has always been showing me the way forward. Back when I was a trainee idol, and when I quit it for a while.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I owe it to her to become a wonderful idol she can be proud of.)
